  • Start the car, and bring it up to running temperature at least once a week.(this will keep you up on the battery's status)
  • Check the air pressure on all tires at least once a week even if you didn't drive it. (spare included)
  • Change the engine oil for each season if needed. Some engines use a different weight of oil at different environmental temps. (winter/summer)
  • Use premium gas so you don't need a fuel stabilizer. (assuming you don't own a diesel)
